description: "The Crofton Boys" by Harriet Martineau is a novel written in the mid-19th century. The story follows a young boy named Hugh Proctor as he navigates his first experiences at a new school—Crofton—where he hopes to find adventure and acceptance among his peers, particularly with his older brother Phil.
